method: Measure actual closed-half grip and actual selected nut; trim each stockM2x8 to L=grip+nut_height+0.55, rechamfer/deburr/gauge6g; final inspect exposed tip0.50..0.65 and full nut engagement. Match/label screw to receiver location. Do NOT blindly cut every screw to7mm.
scope: Analytic manufacturing acceptance/design closure only; all hardware readings remain blank/NOT MEASURED. Full stated convex stack-motion envelope separately required.
